question: How do I add a tenant COI?
baselineResponse: To add a tenant COI, open the Tenant COI List and click New COI. Select the tenant, choose the lease, enter a title, upload the document, set expiry notifications, and save the COI. You can also add or edit policies and compliance rules from the COI details screen.
requiredConcepts: click New COI from the Tenant COI List
search for the tenant by entering at least three characters

question: How do I create a task?
baselineResponse: Go to Setup > Preventive Maintenance > Tasks, click Add Task from the Task Library, enter the property, create the task name, choose the applicable trade, set the interval, add estimated time and instructions, then click Create or Create and View.
requiredConcepts: go to Setup > Preventive Maintenance > Tasks
click Add Task from the Task Library
select the property where the task will take place
use More Options to select a specific time interval
enter the estimated completion time and general instructions
click Create or Create and View
